open_decisions.question: UTLVAL00 is a confirmed utility (control-file-driven data validation: routes by VAL-TYPE 'INTEGRITY' / 'XREF' / 'FORMAT' / 'BALANCE', BR-131; includes the POSREC and TRNREC status domains BR-150 / BR-151). Is UTLVAL00 modernised, retired, replaced by data-quality services, or kept as operational tooling?

UTLVAL00 is classified utility (confirmed): classified as utility (confirmed); a human must decide whether it is in modernisation scope. Keep it in the modernisation scope (resolved_no_change) or exclude it (excluded_from_scope)?

Ten elementary level-01 FD/WS items have no permanent Field ID (PORTTRAN WS-EOF-FLAG, TSTGEN00 SEED-RECORD, TSTVAL00 EXPECTED-RECORD/ACTUAL-RECORD/REPORT-RECORD, UTLMNT00 ARCHIVE-RECORD/REPORT-RECORD, UTLVAL00 ERROR-RECORD, FILEHNDL INPUT-RECORD/OUTPUT-RECORD). Should the reverse data agent register Field IDs for record-level elementary items so their Java types can be fixed?

WS-ERROR-MESSAGE is referenced but declared nowhere in TSTGEN00, TSTVAL00, UTLMNT00, UTLMON00 and UTLVAL00 (it may have been expected from ERRHAND or RTNCODE). What is its intended layout and owning copybook?

In UTLVAL00, COPY POSREC (line 44) and COPY TRNREC (line 45) sit directly under FILE SECTION with no FD, while SELECT POSITION-MASTER and TRANSACTION-HISTORY have no FD. Should POSREC be bound to POSITION-MASTER and TRNREC to TRANSACTION-HISTORY?

Which character encoding do the DISPLAY files of this batch use (assumed EBCDIC code page 037), and must Java preserve EBCDIC collation for indexed keys such as PORT-KEY, VSAM-RECORD-KEY, POS-KEY and TRAN-KEY?

Which character encoding (code page) do the files and areas described by these copybooks use for DISPLAY data on the legacy platform (EBCDIC 037, 1140, another EBCDIC variant, or ASCII)? The zoned-decimal test vectors and String codecs depend on it.

Several data names are declared more than once: CK-FILE-STATUS (CKPRST group line 35 and child line 38); ERR-VALIDATION/ERR-PROCESSING/ERR-SECURITY (RETHND level-88 and STD-ERROR-CODES fields); RC-SUCCESS..RC-CRITICAL, TRN-TYPE-BUY/SELL/FEE, ERROR-CODE and ERROR-ROUTINE across COMMON, RETHND and TRNREC. What Java naming convention should disambiguate them (for example record-qualified class members keyed by Field ID)?

If UTLVAL00 is kept: GAP-021 - eight check paragraphs are not in the source (2210-CHECK-POSITION-INTEGRITY, 2220-CHECK-TRANSACTION-INTEGRITY, 2310-CHECK-POSITION-XREF, 2320-CHECK-TRANSACTION-XREF, 2410-CHECK-POSITION-FORMAT, 2420-CHECK-TRANSACTION-FORMAT, 2510-ACCUMULATE-POSITIONS, 2520-VERIFY-BALANCES); GAP-042 - WS-ERROR-MESSAGE is declared nowhere; GAP-081 - 9999-ERROR-HANDLER never stops the run and may write before ERROR-REPORT is opened. Can the full source be located and the validation rules documented?
